fanOut.note: The main session builds. A subagent runs only for high-volume search (built-in explore) or the fresh reviewer; two in parallel only when both are read-only.

contextBudget.note: Characters injected on EVERY spawn: generated adapter body + each preloaded SKILL.md. Ceilings are agent-owned cost +25%.

complexity.note: Ratchet enforced by check-complexity-budget.mjs. Baselined at current template values.
